features.name: The project's file tree
features.what: The Files panel lists the project's folders and files; folders open and close in place, files and folders carry their git state, and the list follows the disk.
features.reach: Click Files on the right rail of a session.
features.proof: The top-level entries show, a folder opens to its files, a file the agent edited is marked modified.

scenarios.title: The tree lists the project and a folder opens to its files
A file the agent edited is marked modified, an untouched one is not
The search field finds a file by name
A click closes an open folder; Collapse all folders closes every one
A folder counts the changed and new files under it; a new file carries an A
A name nothing matches says so, and clearing the field brings the tree back
node_modules stays hidden until Show gitignored files is on
Refresh lists a file added on disk while the panel is open
A revert in the chat re-lists the folders on screen without a reopen

steps.prompt: Чому білд у CI падає тільки на Windows?

scenarios.title: A file picked in search is scrolled into view in a long tree once the search clears
A listing that failed shows the error with Refresh, and Refresh lists it once the server is back
A click that slips into a tiny drag still opens the folder
Scrolled sideways for a long name, the tree keeps every row's marks at the pane's edge
Turning off Show dotfiles in Settings hides dotfiles from the tree
A project listing that failed shows the error with Refresh, and Refresh lists it once the server is back

features.name: Opening a file
features.what: A file opens in a tab of the editor beside the chat, from the tree or from a path in an answer.
features.reach: Click a file in the Files tree, or click a file path the agent wrote in the chat.
features.proof: A tab with the file's name, the editor shows its content, a Markdown file shows rendered.

scenarios.title: A click in the tree opens the file in a tab; Markdown opens rendered
A file path in an answer opens that file
A click opens a preview tab, a double-click keeps it; the row is marked open and selected

features.name: Editing a file
features.what: The editor saves what the user types to disk and shows a change made to the open file outside the app; the tree shows files added or removed outside the app the next time it is shown.
features.reach: Open a file in Files, type, press Cmd/Ctrl+S; or change the file outside the app while it is open.
features.proof: The file on disk holds the typed text after saving; the editor shows text written outside the app; after closing and opening the panel the tree matches the disk.

scenarios.title: Typing and Cmd/Ctrl+S writes the file to disk

steps.contains: import { withRetry } from "./retry" // edited in verify

scenarios.title: A file changed on disk while open shows the new content
Files deleted and added on disk show after the panel is opened again

features.name: Finding text in files
features.what: The search field switches to file contents: each line that matches is listed with its file, and opening one shows the file at that line; .* makes the query a regular expression.
features.reach: In Files, click the magnifier at the start of the search field and pick File contents.
features.proof: A query lists the files holding it, a click opens the file on the matching line, a pattern matches only with .* on.

scenarios.title: A contents search lists the matching file and opens it at the matching line
A pattern finds nothing as plain text and matches with .* on
A contents match dragged onto the composer mentions its file

features.name: Creating, renaming and deleting files
features.what: The + menu and a row's right-click menu create files and folders, rename, delete, copy the path and download a file; the disk, the tree and the open tabs follow.
features.reach: In Files, the + next to the search field, or right-click a file or folder.
features.proof: The file on disk is created, renamed or gone; the tree shows it; an open tab follows a rename and closes on delete; the clipboard and the download hold the file's path and content.

scenarios.title: + New File creates an empty file at the project root
+ New Folder creates a folder at the project root
New File on a folder's menu creates the file in that folder
Rename moves the file on disk and its open tab follows
Renaming to a name the folder already has says so and changes nothing

steps.text: already has a file or folder named retry.ts

scenarios.title: Delete removes the file from disk and the tree, and the editor stops showing it

steps.text: Are you sure you want to delete client.ts

scenarios.title: Copy Path puts the file's full path on the clipboard
Download saves the file through the browser

features.name: Moving by drag
features.what: A file dragged onto a folder moves there after a confirmation the user can turn off; dropped on the empty part of the tree it moves to the project root; dragged into the chat it is attached instead.
features.reach: In Files, drag a row onto a folder row, onto the space below the rows, or onto the composer.
features.proof: The file is in the new folder on disk and in the tree, the confirmation names it and the folder, a taken name is refused with a toast.

scenarios.title: Dropping a file on a folder asks, then moves it there
Cancel in the confirmation leaves the file where it was
With Don't ask again checked, the next drop moves without asking
Dropping on the space below the rows moves the file to the project root
A folder that already has the name refuses the move with a toast

steps.text: src/lib already has a file or folder named client.ts

scenarios.title: A file dragged onto the composer is mentioned there, not moved
A file found by name dragged onto the composer is mentioned there

features.name: Uploading files
features.what: Files from the computer land in the project: picked through Upload Files, or dropped on a folder or on the tree; a name that exists asks before replacing.
features.reach: In Files, + then Upload Files, a folder's right-click menu, or drag files from the desktop onto the tree.
features.proof: The uploaded file is on disk in the chosen folder with its content and shows in the tree; the drop names its target folder.

scenarios.title: + Upload Files puts the picked file at the project root
Upload Files on a folder's menu puts the file in that folder
Files dropped on a folder row upload into that folder
Files dropped below the rows upload to the project root
Uploading a name that exists asks, and Replace overwrites it
